en: It's rare in my profession that we get a chance to view a puzzle in its entirety! The very source of... well, of all!
It will take time, but I am truly beginning to make sense of this. Please, bring me more.
I'm not feeling very well, my friend. Please leave the scrawlings on the stone there.
But thank you. Voor-sek'ra. Truly, you and I are pioneers of history.
I understand. I am beginning to see the pieces for what they are, every geometrical shape, the makings of... well, of all!
It all connects to the times of old. The pieces, once scattered, return to be reformed. It's happening. The puzzle is nearly complete.
Vak'i-na, I'm so close. How should I proceed?
Remain within the Library
Yes... you're right. Ta'sh-ik. The answers lie within the ever-shifting records. They always did. I just have to see, to make sense of the underlying logic.
Thank you, Vak'i-na.
Seek outside knowledge
Yes... of course! The Library's records are vast, but they pale in comparison to those mentioned by the ancient scholars.
Endless knowledge, kept outside of time. I would've never believed such a place existed, but now... I know I could find their domain. What lies within the lines, I understand it now.
Thank you, my friend. And farewell.
Leave the City
What? Leave? Why would you suggest such a thing? Why...?
This has been my dream, discovering secrets none could have imagined!
I've learned so much. Yet it all feels so... distant.
This place. This City. It seeps into your very being. How long have I wandered the endless stone?
When... how did I arrive here?
Perhaps you are wiser than I am.
Thank you, my friend. I hope we'll meet again someday.
I am beginning to see the pieces for what they are, every geometrical shape, the makings of... well, of all!
I know I could find their domain. What lies within the lines, I understand it now. Thank you, my friend. And farewell.
Perhaps you are wiser than I am. Thank you, my friend. I hope we'll meet again someday.
Glo nat-ki, vana'k p'ta.
Vak'i-na, ut re'hvena. Llio vek-p'ta.
*Bzzt*
Does this thing still work?
The machinery is old but in surprisingly good condition, probably just need to open up the sluiceways to kick it into motion.
Note to self: pack more rope next time.
It broke my pick! Nearly sent me onto the ground.
Fascinating. The mechanism looks to be inscribed with the markings of the artificers.
Perhaps if some manner of equal force was applied.
It's enormous! What a find, shimmering like a gemstone. What I'd give to be able to get close to that thing.
They just won't ever leave. What are they?
The air feels strange.
Some kind of barrier? Doesn't quite match the recorded work of the artificers.
Not much to go on at all... I can barely make out the mechanism above.
Whoever created this must've had a good reason for it, but I haven't found mention of it anywhere.
I've found one of the City's great lifts!
Best I can tell, this one was primarily used to carry Salt from the vats below.
Couldn't find a way to re-activate it on this end.
Drat... Crawled all this way just to face a dead-end.
The great lift should be just above, too!
I was sure there'd be a way.
Come one, come all to the place that unites those of means with their vice—the lifeblood of our great City!
The guiding hand of the aspiring connoisseur, steering you through the extravagant tastes of the well-to-do.
Welcome to the Gilded Emporium!
Pleasantries aside, all must pay the fee to gain access to our wares. Rich or poor, it matters not. I can smell the flesh!
Come one, come all to the place that unites those of means with their vice!
The Flesh... I smell it upon you...
Offer Progenitor Flesh
Splendid... The wonders of the Emporium lay open to you.
Another scrumptious bite. Your offering pleases me.
My form grows, as does my reach. Peruse to your heart's content.
Most delicious...
Through sustaining me, you enrich this world...
Heavenly... I feel new ventures tingling on my strands...
I... grow...
My being... overflows...
I encompass all...
Enough...
Decline
Pity...
I desire growth. My influence is far-reaching, but there remain many places untouched. I urge you to reconsider.
Why will you not let me grow?!
Lone crewman
Is that you, Captain?
No... just another silent specter. Madness without end.
How did we run into the ice... How did I lose you, my friend?
We should never have been parted. If only I could hold you again.
How did I lose you, my friend?
Please. I am all alone.
My friend... missing.
I can't even remember their name...
You found them, didn't you?
Oh...
M-my... friend...
My spores patter against the body of another. You inhale me.
I have felt the vibrations of your movements throughout the Gardens. You stimulate me.
You stand within my domain. You will serve.
The vats grow stale. Must be replenished. Seek the offal jars far below. Feed the vats.
Serve me.
The vats grow stale. Seek the offal jars deep below. Serve me.
I tremble with anticipation...
Venture below... I will feel your presence...
Insolence.
You will serve, or be cast from my domain.
Seek the offal jars below...
My membranes flutter at the scent. You carry Sediment... Pour it into the vats...
Yes...
A dance of ash, viscera, and bone. Cacophonous rebirth.
My membranes thicken. The Gardens thrive.
You have done well.
A gift from the vats.
You inhale me.
You return to do as I command?
At last, the vats overflow...
My membranes grow strong...
You have served me well.
The vats grow stale...
I... wither...
Strange Stalk
Bathe in the light.
Advent of the birth.
Is it not a glorious sight, to see what the tender touch of a god can do?
It rejects constancy... Abhors stagnancy...
Here we thrive... beneath the majesty of Its crimson light.
As Its gaze falls upon this world once more, so do we exist. Tethered to elsewhere.
Are we not beautiful? Nourished by crimson, scorching godlight.
The path lies open. Every day we sprout somewhere new. Journeying by birth.
Since the first Emergence, we have remained, our form limitless beneath Its light.
Stand in the light. Change.
We who exist at Its behest. Once whole, now scattered.
The broken pieces shall converge, and the light remain.
It will reach beyond the cage.
The Divine Remnant undulates rhythmically in tandem with the Stalk.
